A common rough estimate is:

- **About 7,000–8,000 grains of uncooked white rice per US cup (240 ml).**

Details (in case you want them):
- 1 cup of uncooked long‑grain white rice ≈ 185–200 g  
- A single grain typically weighs ≈ 0.02–0.03 g  
- 185 g ÷ 0.025 g ≈ 7,400 grains

Different varieties (short‑grain, brown, wild) will change the number somewhat, but most fall in roughly the **6,000–10,000 grains per cup** range, with ~7,500 as a good working figure.
